rules.title: Prohibition on nonrefundable security
rules.requirement: A lease or rental agreement may not contain a provision characterizing any security as nonrefundable.
rules.coverage_text: Leases and rental agreements that include a security.
rules.penalty: Bad faith claim or retention of the security or any portion thereof in violation of this section may subject the landlord or successors in interest to statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages.
rules.quoted_span: (n) A lease or rental agreement shall not contain a provision characterizing any security as “nonrefundable.”

rules.title: Transfer or return of security on termination of landlord's interest
rules.requirement: When the landlord's interest in the premises ends (by sale, assignment, death, receivership or otherwise), the landlord must within a reasonable time either transfer the remaining security to the successor in interest and notify the tenant, or return the remaining security to the tenant with an accounting. Before a voluntary transfer, the landlord must give the successor a written statement of the remaining security, itemized deductions and the election made.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords holding a tenant's security whose interest in the premises terminates, and their successors in interest.
rules.penalty: On noncompliance with subdivision (i), the landlord's successors in interest are jointly and severally liable with the landlord for repayment of the security; bad faith demand of replacement security may subject the landlord or successors to statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages.
